en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ismail Bin Marrar, from Yunus, fro one of his companions, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘The man must not be made to swear except based upon his knowledge, and the oath would not take place except upon the knowledge, whether he has been made to swear or not made to swear’.
en.sarwar: 4. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ’Isma‘il ibn Marrar from Yunus from certain persons of his people who has narrated the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
A man must not be asked to take an oath except for what he knows and that oath applies only to what he knows, regardless, one is asked to swear or not’”
